dedupeResult: The complete accessible open pull-request patch and repository code search were checked for each official name, domain, canonical route and exact public address. No existing Stonx Music, Red Devil Radio or WCOM music-submission-agent record was found. Each platform is stored once; general contacts, protected role mailboxes, artist pages, voting pages, donations, underwriting and physical/electronic variants are consolidated or excluded.
emailVerificationLevel: Demo@StonxMusic.co.uk, Hello@StonxMusic.co.uk, Mgmt@StonxMusic.co.uk and stationmanager@wcomfm.org are first-party published, syntactically valid and exactly domain-aligned. Only the Stonx demo address is authorized for new music submissions. Red Devil Radio publishes four role-specific exact-domain mailboxes behind Cloudflare protection; their local parts were not decoded or inferred and the account portal remains canonical. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
formVerificationLevel: Red Devil Radio exposes a first-party authenticated upload workflow requiring account creation, email verification, a submission credit, one MP3, cover art, context and agreement acceptance. WCOM publishes a host-specific first-party form, but passive inspection showed a one-submission/session message, so fields, upload mechanism and hidden controls remain incomplete. Stonx uses a public email/private-link route. No field, account, verification email, credit, upload, link, agreement, CAPTCHA, payment, host selection or physical delivery was exercised.
safety: No email was sent, no form field was filled, no account was created, no email verification occurred, no credit was spent, no audio, private link, cover art, metadata or package was shared, no CAPTCHA or session control was tested, no agreement was accepted, no payment was used and no submission or platform restriction was bypassed.
